$comment: Codex-layout hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart/PreCompact/PostCompact rehydrate beads context; PostToolUse arms session markers; PermissionRequest auto-approves bro/bd; Stop runs the gate. PLUGIN_ROOT is what Codex exports — same fail-open chain as other adapters (run.sh → bro on PATH → npx).

hooks.command: P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks session-start || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks session-start || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" pre-compact || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks pre-compact || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks pre-compact || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" post-compaction || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks post-compaction || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks post-compaction || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" prompt-submit || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks prompt-submit || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks prompt-submit || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" post-tool || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks post-tool || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks post-tool || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" permission || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks permission || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks permission || true; fi; exit 0

P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -f "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" stop || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro hooks >/dev/null 2>&1; then bro hooks stop || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx -y --prefer-offline "@broject/bro@0.2.4" hooks stop || true; fi; exit 0
